_about: books that teach what hides and the tanner's stores do, the herbal, smithing, enchanting
and alchemy manuals' counterpart. Reading one takes hours of world time and teaches the
properties it lists; the bench pays its mastery once (leatherworking-lore.json `manual`,
rules/knowledge.py `read_manual`). Read by rules/knowledge.py; sold at every settlement's
Original writing for Pathfinder GM (2026-10-08). Prices in gold, in the other crafts'
range (6 to 25 gp for the common books, the monster-hide book dearer as the deep-metals
book is). `teaches` names materials by id and says which of each one's properties the
book holds: "all", "benefits", "drawbacks", "working", or a list of property
keys. The words are preferred over keys: keys are positions in a material's lists, and
a data pass can move them. An id the materials do not hold is skipped, never invented.

manuals.name: The Tanner's Yard Book
manuals.about: A village tanner's account of the hides that come over the yard wall every season, and what each one makes.

manuals.name: Bark, Brine and Brains
manuals.about: The country tannages, pit by pit: which bark, how much salt, and why the old way with brains still works.

manuals.name: Needle, Awl and Wax
manuals.about: A saddler's pocket book of threads, waxes and dressings, with a note on each one's failings.

manuals.name: The Dyer's Card
manuals.about: A swatch book: every colour pinned beside the same colour after a month of rain.

manuals.name: Furs of the Hard Country
manuals.about: A trapper's book of the big pelts from cold and wild places, written for the buyer who means to wear them.

manuals.name: The Monster-Skinner's Ledger
manuals.about: Notes on the hides of beasts that kill people, kept by someone who sold them, with the warnings the author learned at the flensing beam.
